Resolve sensor freshness and validity propagation; peer timeout, authority arbitration and startup after primary loss; independent inverted safety observations; controller software deployment and timing; recording/telemetry power, retention and arbitration. Existing IC-01 mass and energy allowances are hypotheses, not a bill of materials or installed-load evidence.

Navigation signaling has a context responsibility and requirements but no detailed logical interface or IC-01 equipment allocation. Optional observation payload and future harvesting remain outside this finite-Gorge implementation. Hull/rig composition and operator launch/pickup stay in their physical and human descriptions; they are not fictitious controller functions.

interpretation: Native ownership, endpoint coverage, mapping scope and configuration checks only. Internal mappings are implementation obligations, not executed software. Interface timing, protocol, authority arbitration, supply and independence decisions remain open; no physical qualification verdict is assigned.
